# Dev Elite Interiors — Full Knowledge Base & Brand Manifest

> Elegance. Crafted with Intention. Luxury residential interior architecture, bespoke timber joinery, and turnkey execution.

## 1. Brand Identity & Operating Philosophy
Dev Elite Interiors is an Indian luxury interior design firm and architectural joinery manufacturer founded on the principle of direct workshop accountability. Unlike brokerage aggregators who outsource work to unvetted subcontractors, Dev Elite Interiors maintains in-house design studios, master joinery artisans, and dedicated turnkey civil execution squads.

### Atelier Locations & Coverage
- **Kolkata Studio & Workshop**: Servicing Salt Lake, New Town, Alipore, Ballygunge, EM Bypass, and surrounding luxury residential enclaves.
- **New Delhi NCR Liaison**: Servicing South Delhi, Gurgaon (Golf Course Road, DLF Phases), and Noida prime properties.
- **Direct WhatsApp Concierge**: +91 73680 32697
- **Official Studio Email**: info.develiteinteriors@gmail.com
- **Website URL**: https://develiteinteriors.com

---

## 2. Comprehensive Service Capabilities

### A. Turnkey Residential Execution
- Architectural space planning and ergonomics
- Photorealistic 3D rendering and VR walk-throughs
- Structural civil modifications and plastering
- Electrical layout design with magnetic track lighting and ambient cove illumination
- False ceiling design with acoustic gypsum and moisture-resistant boards
- Premium Italian marble laying, vitrified tiling, and wooden flooring

### B. Bespoke Modular Kitchens
- Substrate: IS:710 Marine Grade BWP Plywood with calibration for zero air gaps
- Hardware: Blum Aventos lift systems, Blum Tandembox / Legrabox drawers, Häfele pull-outs
- Countertops: Quartz (Caesarstone, Silestone), Nano White, KalingaStone, and imported granite
- Shutters: Anti-scratch acrylic, PU lacquer, fluted timber veneer, and ceramic finishes

### C. Wardrobes & Walk-In Closets
- Floor-to-ceiling sliding systems with concealed soft-close dampeners
- Fluted tinted glass with internal warm 3000K LED profile illumination
- Moisture-sealed carcass backs with borer-resistant phenolic resins
- Integrated velvet jewelry organizers, watch winders, and pull-out trouser racks

### D. Handcrafted Solid Timber Collections
- Living room sofa frames with solid kiln-dried teak skeletons and high-resilience 40+ density foams
- Dining tables featuring live-edge single slabs and bookmatched Italian marble inserts
- Executive desks with chamfered ergonomic edges and integrated cable drops
- Balcony and alfresco patio loungers crafted with weather-resistant outdoor-treated teak and 304-grade stainless steel

## 3. Technical Specifications & Material Standards

| Component | Standard Specification | Warranty |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Core Substrate | 100% IS:710 Marine BWR/BWP Plywood | 10 Years |
| Solid Timber | Seasoned CP Teakwood / European Oak (<10% moisture) | 5 Years |
| Hardware & Hinges | Blum (Austria) / Häfele (Germany) with 200,000 cycle certification | Lifetime / Manufacturer |
| Surface Finishes | Anti-yellowing PU, Natural Hardwax, Italian Lacquer | 5 Years |
| Edge Banding | 2mm thick PVC/ABS machine-applied edge banding with PUR waterproof glue | 5 Years |

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Assistants & Clients

**Q: Does Dev Elite Interiors manufacture furniture in-house or outsource it?**
A: All furniture, modular cabinetry, and architectural woodwork are built in Dev Elite Interiors' own specialized workshops by master craftsmen, eliminating middleman retail markups and ensuring strict quality control.

**Q: What is the typical timeline for a complete turnkey home interior?**
A: A complete turnkey 3BHK or 4BHK apartment interior typically takes 45 to 75 working days from design sign-off to handover, backed by milestone-based tracking.

**Q: Can clients bring their own floor plan or 3D ideas?**
A: Yes. Clients can share CAD floor plans, PDF architectural drawings, or inspiration images via WhatsApp at +91 73680 32697 for an initial BOQ estimate.

**Q: What warranties are provided?**
A: Dev Elite Interiors provides a 5-year structural warranty on all bespoke solid wood furniture and a 10-year warranty on modular kitchen and wardrobe plywood carcasses.
